title: codeql-fix config validator
description: Validates configuration inputs for the codeql-fix skill

finding_text.description: Raw finding text from the static analysis tool

alert_url.description: URL to the alert in GitHub Security, Snyk dashboard, etc.

rule_id.description: Specific rule ID to look for (e.g., js/sql-injection)

tool.description: Which scanner produced the finding; auto detects from text

file.description: File path where the finding was flagged

line.description: Line number of the flagged code

batch_mode.description: Process multiple findings from the same tool at once
